description: Answer-engine readiness. Passive reads of the page head, body and public discovery files. Never enters the eight category scores.

checks.title: Page has a clear title
checks.recommendation: Give the page a specific title that says what the product is.

checks.title: Page has a meta description
checks.recommendation: Add a meta description that states what the product does and for whom, in one or two sentences.

checks.title: Page declares its language
checks.recommendation: Set the lang attribute on the html element.

checks.title: Page has one canonical address
checks.recommendation: Add a canonical link so answer engines cite one address.

checks.title: Page has structured data
checks.recommendation: Add JSON-LD for Organization or Product (and FAQPage if you answer questions on the page).

checks.title: Crawlers are not blocked
checks.recommendation: Allow the search and answer-engine crawlers you want in robots.txt, or remove the blanket disallow.

checks.title: Page is not marked noindex
checks.recommendation: Remove noindex from the page if you want it found.

checks.title: Site offers an llms.txt
checks.recommendation: Optional: publish /llms.txt with a short map of your key pages. Treated as an emerging practice, not a requirement.

checks.title: Page has one main heading
checks.recommendation: Use exactly one h1 that names the product.

checks.title: Page has enough readable text
checks.recommendation: Pages with almost no text give answer engines nothing to quote. Add a plain-language summary.

checks.title: Page has social preview data
checks.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description and og:image so shared links read well.
